title: 柔韧性评估
requirements: Accepted sources have a real alpha channel and were visually checked on a neutral background.
Each scene uses one Bojji and one Despa with no readable text, floor, room, cast shadow, duplicate pose or sequence framing.
Overview art is independently generated and compositionally distinct from its corresponding knowledge image.
Flexibility assessment remains non-diagnostic: range, control, repeatable setup and safe stopping are shown without forced stretching.

accepted.review: Calm shoulder reach with an untouching observer and plain folded strap; no forced stretch, score or medical framing.
A comfortable arm raise and non-contact observation distinguish usable range from control.
Blank choice card, shoulder-reach position and isolated stool communicate goal-led test selection without a global verdict.
Controlled hip hinge and blank position guide communicate a repeatable setup without diagnosing asymmetry.
A single diagonal resistance band connects low and raised hands, showing controlled shoulder work rather than a maximal stretch.
Mutual open-palm stop signals clearly show consent, pain boundaries and no-contact distance.
Three-quarter shoulder-height stance is distinct from the first knowledge illustration.
Distinct overhead loop, blank choice card and low stool form a compact task-selection panel.
Neutral stance and blank position guide support consistent setup without a marked measurement.
Compact band scene is compositionally independent from the diagonal knowledge-page shoulder work.
Clear reciprocal stop signals state the safety boundary without a forced pose or medical framing.

rejected.reason: Both hands held the band horizontally at the chest, omitting the controlled raised-arm action needed for the activity-and-control lesson point.
